description: This file defines a Retrofit-based network data source for the NowInAndroid app, including API interface, data models, and implementation for network calls to fetch topics, news resources, and change lists.

classes.name: RetrofitNiaNetworkApi
classes.description: Private interface defining Retrofit API endpoints for fetching topics, news resources, and change lists.

classes.name: NetworkResponse
classes.description: Serializable generic wrapper for network responses containing data of type T.

classes.name: RetrofitNiaNetwork
classes.description: Singleton class implementing NiaNetworkDataSource using Retrofit to perform network operations.

methods.name: getTopics
methods.description: Fetches a list of NetworkTopic objects for given IDs.

methods.name: getNewsResources
methods.description: Fetches a list of NetworkNewsResource objects for given IDs.

methods.name: getTopicChangeList
methods.description: Retrieves change list for topics after a specified ID.

methods.name: getNewsResourceChangeList
methods.description: Retrieves change list for news resources after a specified ID.
